'''Holly''' is found via [[foraging]] in the [[Winter]].  Holly can be found throughout Stardew Valley, including in the [[Secret Woods]].

==Bundles==
*Holly has a chance to be used in the {{Bundle|Winter Remixed||y}}. 
*Five Holly may be used as one of the options for the {{Bundle|Winter Star||y}}.

==Recipes==
Holly is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Holly is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt035.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Fancy Red Blouse]]. It can also be used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, located at [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Holly is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].
